name: Burujiru
source:
Main character adores bloomers and dreams about having sex with a girl in bloomers. But bloomers get forbidden everywhere and gradually disappear from this world. Then angel comes down and grants his wish for three days time. There is a girl who can't stay girl because of her parents' issue. And bloomers looks so good on her...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-december-2006-kimi-no-koe.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角喜欢灯笼裤，并梦想与穿着灯笼裤的女孩发生性关系。但灯笼裤到处都被禁止，并逐渐从这个世界上消失。然后天使降临并实现了他三天的愿望。有一个女孩因为父母的问题而无法保持女孩的身份。而且灯笼裤穿在她身上也很好看……

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-december-2006-kimi-no-koe.html]vndbreview[/url]]
